functions.name: duix_avatar_version
functions.description: Returns a version identifier for the duix_avatar component. Typical usage is to retrieve the library/component version at runtime for compatibility checks or diagnostics. No arguments are required.
requirements: No preconditions; may be called at any time after the library is linked/loaded.
Caller should interpret the returned int according to the library’s versioning scheme (unknown from header).

functions.name: duix_avatar_hello
functions.description: Returns a read-only C string associated with the duix_avatar component, likely a greeting or identifier string. Useful for sanity checks or simple diagnostics. Exact content and lifetime of the returned pointer are not documented in the header and are therefore unknown.
requirements: The returned pointer refers to read-only data; the caller must not modify the memory pointed to by the returned const char*.
Ownership is not transferred; the caller must not free or delete the returned pointer.

The lifetime/validity period of the returned pointer is not specified in the header; callers should treat it as implementation-defined and avoid storing it beyond immediate use unless documented elsewhere.
